instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: LegalTech startup providing an AI-powered contract lifecycle management platform for SME legal departments. Automating contract review, clause extraction, obligation tracking, and renewal management. 150 customers across Europe. Expanding into regulatory change monitoring with automated contract impact analysis. We are a bootstrapped company with a lean team. Every euro of investment must show near-immediate ROI given our constrained working capital. The founder is involved in all strategic decisions including innovation priorities.
answers.pastInitiatives: Our digital transformation program is in its third year with a dedicated transformation office reporting to the CEO. We have completed an ERP migration to the cloud, rolled out a company-wide data warehouse with self-service BI dashboards, and established a center of excellence for process automation using RPA and low-code tools. The program has delivered €2.4M in annualized cost savings to date.
answers.strategicGoals: Customer retention has declined from 92% to 84% over the past 18 months, primarily among our mid-tier and enterprise segments. Exit interviews consistently cite product stagnation and poor digital self-service tools as reasons for leaving. We need to urgently modernize our customer-facing technology and proactively address the specific pain points driving churn before the trend becomes irreversible.
answers.teamSize: We have 2 generalist developers who split their time between maintaining our existing systems, handling customer support escalations, and occasionally prototyping new features. There is no dedicated innovation or R&D role — innovation happens when these developers have spare cycles between urgent operational tasks, which is rare.
answers.additionalContext: We are in the final stages of being acquired by a larger international group. The deal is expected to close in 3 months. The acquiring company has a strong reputation for technology-driven operations, and we anticipate significant investment in modernizing our systems post-acquisition. In the interim, we are in a holding pattern — major strategic decisions require acquirer approval, but we can prepare by auditing our current state and identifying quick wins.

input.changes_since_last: Product launch successful — 3 new features shipped. Customer NPS improved 20 points. Backlog of technical debt growing.

opportunities.title: Customer Experience (CX) Modernization for Retention Defense
opportunities.rationale: The primary threat is customer churn due to perceived product stagnation and poor self-service tools. This initiative leverages the existing data warehouse and automation successes to build a dedicated, modern customer portal focused entirely on reducing friction points cited in exit interviews.

first_actions: Conduct deep dive into the top 3 pain points from churn/exit interviews (e.g., status checking, document retrieval).
Prototype a lightweight self-service portal using low-code tools available in the current tech stack.
Formalize and secure dedicated developer time (minimum 50% allocation) specifically for CX backlog reduction, protecting it from operational tasks.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in support tickets related to 'information retrieval' or 'status checks' by 25% within 6 months.
milestones: Wireframe validation with 10 key mid-tier customers (Month 1).
MVP self-service dashboard deployment for internal QA (Month 3).
Pilot rollout to 10% of the churn-risk customer base (Month 4).

opportunities.title: Acquisition Readiness Value Audit & MVP Package
opportunities.rationale: With an expected acquisition in 3 months, the priority shifts to demonstrating immediate, quantifiable value. This involves packaging the successful process improvements (ERP migration savings, RPA governance) into a documented 'digital maturity audit' and proving its reliability via a mini-MVP.

first_actions: Compile all documentation detailing the €2.4M cost savings achieved through transformation processes.
Identify 1 high-impact, low-effort process (e.g., automated contract summary generation) that can be showcased as a 'ready-to-scale' feature for the acquirer.
Develop and finalize a clean, digestible pitch deck mapping internal efficiencies to buyer value propositions.
execution_plan.success_metric: Completion of the 'Value Audit Package' and presentation readiness for the acquisition due diligence team.
milestones: Successful internal dry-run demonstration of the featured MVP process (Month 2).
Final review and sign-off on audit materials (Month 3).

next_steps.action: Establish and protect a dedicated 50% developer allocation solely for the Customer Experience (CX) modernization project, shielding it from immediate operational support tickets.
Formalize a 'Digital Value Mapping' workshop with the Transformation Office and CEO to quantify all achieved cost savings (€2.4M) into acquisition-relevant metrics.
Identify an external, part-time UX/UI contractor to accelerate the initial wireframing and validation of the self-service portal prototype.

key_weaknesses: Lack of sustained, dedicated developer bandwidth due to reactive operational demands (bottleneck).
Failure to translate internal process efficiencies into tangible, modern customer-facing digital tools.
Over-reliance on the founder for strategic decision-making and prioritization, slowing execution velocity.

improvements: Successfully established a formal process improvement structure (Transformation Office).
Achieved significant measurable cost savings (€2.4M) via ERP migration, RPA, and data warehouse implementation.
Product development capacity demonstrated by shipping 3 new customer-facing features.
persistent_gaps: Customer retention remains critically low (84%), indicating strategic product/UX gaps persist despite internal process gains.
The technical debt continues to grow, threatening the stability and scalability of the core platform.
The operational structure is improving faster than the customer-facing experience.
achieved_milestones: Completion of major infrastructure upgrades (ERP migration/Data Warehouse).
Successful deployment of process automation tools (RPA, low-code tools).

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: The company has significantly improved its operational maturity and governance structure (formal process realized). The execution capability is high, but this internal success has not yet translated into solving the critical market problem of customer retention/user experience.
